Siemens._comment: NCR site 'Seimens' (city NCR, 2 nonveg_main slots). Logics from the client sheet + the 27-Jul / 03-Aug sample weeks. Deferred/outside lunch scope: tetrapack juice (snacks), and brown bread / cut fruit / boiled egg (breakfast) are not lunch slots this engine plans. Kofta 'once per 2 weeks' is capped to <=1/week here (a true fortnightly window needs saved history).
Siemens._disable_comment: deep_fried_coupling (the Bangalore rice-bread/deep-fried family rule) conflicts with 'plain chapati every day' — it links bread to the deep-fried rice/veg-dry family and cannot be satisfied when bread is pinned to plain chapati on this simple North-Indian counter. Not relevant to NCR's menu, so dropped.

rules._comment: Two non-veg in the gravy part. Tuesday = one egg + one chicken; every other day = both chicken. components (default) applies Mon/Wed/Thu/Fri; components_by_weekday overrides Tuesday. Salad (green salad) and bread (plain chapati) are daily constants in the constant_items block below.
rules.name: siemens_nonveg_pair_by_weekday

rules._comment: One paneer a week (in the veg gravy).
rules.name: siemens_paneer_1x

rules._comment: One soya a week (soya chaap, in the veg gravy). This used to be an any_of over primary_protein soya AND soy, because NCR spelled the protein both ways — 37 rows soya against 21 soy — so either selector alone missed most of the family. Chain rules/protein_key_ingredients.py folded the column to the canonical `soy`, so one selector now reaches all 58 NCR rows and the workaround is gone.
rules.name: siemens_soya_1x

rules._comment: Kofta at most once a WEEK within a plan (within-plan half of once-per-2-weeks).
rules.name: siemens_kofta_max_1

rules._comment: Kofta once every 2 WEEKS (14 days) across plans, from saved history: a kofta served in the last 14 days is held off until the window clears. Pairs with siemens_kofta_max_1.
rules.name: siemens_kofta_14d_window

constant_items._comment: salad = green salad daily; bread = plain chapati daily.

Siemens._disable_why: Siemens serves TWO nonveg dishes and its own rule says what they are: 'Tue one egg + one chicken, other days two chicken'. The city composition `nonveg_main_daily_pair` also composes this slot (one nonveg DRY + one gravy every day), and rules merge by NAME — so a client rule under its own name STACKS on the city one instead of replacing it. The stack demands the intersection: a chicken dry AND a chicken gravy, distinct, every day. Measured: with two weeks saved, week 3 is INFEASIBLE from three separate start Mondays (3 Aug, 7 Sep, 5 Oct), and exactly three single-rule removals fix it — this city composition, the client rule, or `item_cooldown_20d`. NCR carries only 12 nonveg-dry rows of which 10 are chicken, against 108 gravies, so the dry half of the pair is the thin one; the slot itself never looks starved (105 candidates, 77 chicken in week 3), which is why the pre-flight gate reports would_succeed and the solve then fails naming no rule. The client's sentence is about PROTEIN and says nothing about dry/gravy, so the specific rule wins for this client and no other.
